INSERT INTO products (name, description, category, image_url, is_active) VALUES 
('Road Warrior Tee', 'The official uniform of the hive. Garment-dyed heavyweight cotton that gets softer with every wash and every mile. Features the iconic F2D motorcycle bee on the front. Built for long rides and longer nights.', 'apparel', '/images/products/road-warrior-tee.jpg', 1),
('Beekeeper Tank', 'For when the sun is high and the road is calling. Premium cotton tank featuring our skeleton beekeeper on a chopper. Perfect for showing off your ink while repping the swarm. Warning: May cause excessive compliments at gas stations.', 'apparel', '/images/products/beekeeper-tank.jpg', 1),
('Hive Mind Cap', 'Five panels of pure attitude. Features our embroidered bee head patch on the front. Low profile, structured crown, snapback closure. The official headgear of the hive.', 'apparel', '/images/products/hive-mind-cap.jpg', 1),
('Swarm Hoodie', 'Premium heavyweight pullover for when the temperature drops but your attitude doesnt. Subtle bee logo on the chest says you know. Fleece-lined for warmth, black for stealth. The perfect layer between you and the world.', 'apparel', '/images/products/swarm-hoodie.jpg', 1);
